infoModal.intro: OpenAirMap is an open source project by AirCarto and AtmoSud to display real-time air quality measurements from monitoring stations and micro-sensors. Data on the map is fetched from various data APIs. This application is constantly evolving. For questions and suggestions, please open an issue on the project's GitHub.
infoModal.dataListNote: For some devices, data is not available for all time steps (2 min, 15 min, hourly, daily). In that case the icon is greyed out.

atmo-micro.description: Micro-sensors deployed by AtmoSud. Hourly data is consolidated

modeling-pm.description: Hourly fine particle modeling over the PACA region.

infoModal.discoverHistoricalText: Historical mode lets you replay a pollution episode or a typical day. Select a past date then use the time slider to step through available measurements. Data updates on the map and in related panels so you can see how the situation evolved over time.
infoModal.discoverHistoricalBullet1: First choose the period in the dedicated selector.
infoModal.discoverHistoricalBullet2: Then set the playback speed or move manually with the slider.
infoModal.discoverHistoricalBullet3: Start playback by clicking the "Play" button.
infoModal.discoverHistoricalBullet4: Exit historical mode by clicking the "Historical mode" button again.
infoModal.comparisonText: Multi-sensor comparison lets you analyse several devices at once. Enable it from the side panel to select up to five sensors or stations and view their time series side by side in the charts.
infoModal.comparisonBullet1: Select sensors directly on the map.
infoModal.comparisonBullet2: Data is automatically added to the comparison chart.
infoModal.comparisonBullet3: Exit comparison mode by clicking the "Disable comparison" button.
infoModal.footer: OpenAirMap is constantly improving. Share your feedback via our site

step1.title: Discover historical mode
step1.description: This mode lets you replay air quality over a past period. It is only available for 15-minute, hourly and daily time steps.

step2.title: Enable historical mode
step2.description: Click this button to enable the mode. Current markers will be replaced by data for the selected period.

step3.title: Choose a period
step3.description: Select a start and end date. AtmoRef, AtmoMicro and NebuleAir sources are supported. Maximum period length depends on the time step (7 days at 15 min, 30 days hourly).

step4.title: Load data
step4.description: Once the period is selected, click here to load historical measurements on the map.

step5.title: Playback controls
step5.description: Use play/pause, the timeline and speed to navigate through time. This panel is draggable; reopen the calendar via the icon at the top right.
